templates.name: AI Addendum
templates.description: Addendum that supplements a Cloud Service Agreement or Software License Agreement when the product includes AI services, covering input and output ownership, usage restrictions, training data, and AI-specific warranties.

templates.name: Business Associate Agreement
templates.description: HIPAA Business Associate Agreement between a covered entity and a business associate, governing the permitted uses and disclosures of protected health information and the safeguards required to protect it.

templates.name: Cloud Service Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms for selling and buying cloud software and SaaS products, covering subscriptions, order forms, payment, data protection, warranties, indemnities, and limitations of liability.

templates.name: Data Processing Agreement
templates.description: Data processing terms for a provider handling personal data on behalf of a customer, addressing GDPR and similar privacy law requirements including subprocessors, security measures, and international transfers.

templates.name: Design Partner Agreement
templates.description: Agreement for collaborating with an early customer on developing a product, covering feedback, access to pre-release software, confidentiality, and ownership of the resulting intellectual property.

templates.name: Mutual NDA Standard Terms
templates.description: Standard terms of the mutual non-disclosure agreement, defining confidential information, permitted uses and disclosures, the confidentiality period, and the return or destruction of materials.

templates.name: Mutual NDA Cover Page
templates.description: Fill-in cover page for the mutual non-disclosure agreement, capturing the parties, purpose, term, confidentiality period, and governing law, and incorporating the MNDA standard terms by reference.

templates.name: Partnership Agreement
templates.description: Agreement between two companies collaborating commercially, where each party's obligations are set out in the cover page, and covering fees, trademark licensing, an escalation procedure, and term and termination.

templates.name: Pilot Agreement
templates.description: Short-term agreement letting a prospective customer trial or evaluate a product before committing to a longer-term deal, with a limited scope, reduced time commitment, and simple termination.

templates.name: Professional Services Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms for providing professional services under statements of work, covering deliverables, acceptance, fees and expenses, ownership of work product, and service warranties.

templates.name: Service Level Agreement
templates.description: Service level terms designed to accompany the Cloud Service Agreement, defining uptime commitments, support response times, service credits, and exclusions such as scheduled maintenance.

templates.name: Software License Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms for licensing self-hosted or on-premise software, covering the license grant and restrictions, order forms, delivery, support, and intellectual property indemnification.
